method: Twelve new directed comparisons across seven repaired and five supporting pages. All seven receive incoming and outgoing links. Existing comparisons preserved; links remain within the selected language. Five supporting destinations verified as canonical indexable HTTP 200 pages with attributed descriptions.

edges.label: The Broken Link
edges.reason: Compare Norrie’s distrust of Bruno with Janey’s doubts about a reunion in another romance shaped by an earlier broken promise.

edges.label: Fatal Deception
edges.reason: Try another romance in which a woman’s unresolved feelings must be weighed against an earlier betrayal and concern for her family.

edges.label: Interculturele samenwerking in organisaties
edges.reason: Verplaats de aandacht van arbeidsbemiddeling naar samenwerken op de werkvloer, met een boek over culturele verschillen binnen organisaties.

edges.label: Koppensnellers, uitrangeerders en selecteurs
edges.reason: Bekijk naast samenwerking binnen organisaties ook een historische benadering van het beroep van arbeidsbemiddelaar.

edges.label: Activiteit en begrip
edges.reason: Vergelijk dit historische onderzoek naar rechtscolleges met Van Oers’ moderne theoretische benadering van onderwijs, leren en begripsvorming.

edges.label: Viglius van Aytta als hoogleraar te Ingolstadt
edges.reason: Voor een historische vergelijking met onderwijstheorie: lees hoe Pikkemaat het juridische onderwijs van Viglius van Aytta onderzoekt.

edges.label: Visual Culture
edges.reason: Compare Rivera’s reflections on art with Boylan’s contemporary introduction to how images shape the way people see and understand their world.

edges.label: Diego Rivera: Illustrious Words, 1886–1921
edges.reason: Read an artist’s own reflections on art through this illustrated collection of Rivera’s writings from his formative years.

edges.label: International Law
edges.reason: Move from locating legal institutions and information sources to studying legal principles in Klabbers’s textbook on international law.

edges.label: Law and Legal Information Directory
edges.reason: For a different kind of legal reference work, explore this historical directory of organizations, services and information sources.

edges.label: An American Plague
edges.reason: Compare this long-term demographic study with a history for younger readers about Philadelphia’s yellow fever crisis in 1793.

edges.label: Fertility, Food and Fever
edges.reason: For a broader historical comparison, explore how disease, food supply and population change are connected in Henley’s study of Sulawesi.
